title: Italian Grand Prix Practice Shows Russell Fastest as Teams Clash Over Engines
flags: George Russell topped the second free‑practice session, with Charles Leclerc right on his tail, according to *grandprix247* (1.5 h ago)

The practice sheet released by *the‑race.com* (36 min ago) shows Russell leading with a lap time that left the rest of the field scrambling. Leclerc was second, while **Lewis Hamilton** and **Max Verstappen** were a few tenths behind
Bet9ja and Sportybet usually tighten the odds on a driver who tops FP2, so you’ll see *value* drift towards the mid‑range
As the weekend progresses, bookmakers will adjust Mercedes‑driver odds (Russell, Hamilton) lower, while Ferrari’s odds (Leclerc, Sainz) may stay static or rise slightly
If you spot a *downward drift* in his odds on Sportybet, that could be a chance to place a *long‑shot* bet on a surprise top‑5 finish

Many African bookmakers now list a separate market for “first safety‑car deployment.” When engines are pushed harder, the probability of a safety car rises – especially at a high‑speed circuit like Monza. Compare Bet9ja’s “first safety car” price with Betway’s; the one offering *higher odds* may reflect a market that still underestimates the risk
